summary: Clinton County, NY: 60-ft Aermotor LS40 lookout built 1930 to back up Whiteface; active 1979-1988, closed 1989; still stands on private land, not open to the public.

facts.design: 60-foot Aermotor LS40 steel tower with an observer's cabin

access.note: On private property and not open to the public (Wikipedia; NYSFFLA)

events.note: Built by the Conservation Department on the summit, with an observer's cabin, to supplement the Whiteface Mountain tower
Operated for part of the 1930 season and reported nine fires
Closed in early 1971 with the advent of aerial detection and placed on the inactive list
Active until closing at the end of the 1988 season
Officially closed in early 1989 after DEC determined that towers were no longer effective and decided to phase them out

notes_for_editor: Wikipedia and the NYSFFLA entry agree on 1930, the 1971 closure, the 1979 reactivation, the end of 1988 and the early-1989 closure. A Facebook group snippet (not fetched, not cited) gives a 1977 or 1978 reactivation; it conflicts with both and was left out. FFLA lists the tower as standing, but no recent condition report or photo was found, so 'standing' rests on listings and the Wikipedia and NYSFFLA wording that it remains. The owner is not named. The brief's record (standing, no staffing) was consistent with sources; no correction. Used 1 WebSearch and about 3 page reads.
